description: This file defines the DownloadItem data model and the DownloadController class, which manages download states, persistence, and simulation of download progress within a Flutter application. It interacts with a SQLite database and a download engine to handle and coordinate download operations.

classes.name: DownloadItem
classes.description: Data model representing a download's state, including identifiers, progress, status, and timestamps.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing download operations, persisting state, and notifying UI components about changes.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Loads download queue and items from SQLite, updates internal state, and resumes in-progress downloads if not paused.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download item to the persistent store and initiates download simulation if the queue is not paused.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a download from the persistent store and cancels its ongoing download.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the global download queue pause state, updating all active or queued downloads accordingly.

methods.name: pauseItem
methods.description: Pauses a specific download item without affecting the global queue state.

methods.name: resumeItem
methods.description: Resumes a specific paused download item if the global queue is active.

methods.name: _startSimulation
methods.description: Starts the download progress simulation for a given content ID, updating progress via callback.
